displayIdentity.body: Jesus follows his custom to the Mount, tells disciples to pray against temptation, kneels, prays about the cup and divine will, receives angelic strengthening, and finds grief-filled sleep.
displayIdentity.title: On the Mount of Olives Jesus prays and finds sleeping disciples
